name: Smashing Magazine

rules_quotes.quote: We do have sponsored post options for companies who would like to increase their visibility while sponsoring great content.
While your experience in your company and with your product is valuable, pieces full of links to your product, or which are a walkthrough of how to use your product, will be rejected.

notes: Web design and front-end magazine; outsiders pitch an article idea with an outline through the write-for-us form.

name: Towards Data Science

rules_quotes.quote: Is your conclusion to the point and not promotional?
Adding an extra link to your author profile or to a social media account is fine, but please avoid call-to-action (CTA) buttons.
Any image you use on TDS must be licensed for commercial use, including AI-generated images.

notes: Data science and AI publication; writers submit original articles through the TDS submission process.

name: Lilach Bullock

rules_quotes.quote: The article teaches before it promotes and is not vendor copy wearing an editorial byline.
One contextual backlink to your own site or a relevant resource is fine in an editorial post.

notes: Marketing and AI consultant blog with topic-specific guest post pages; pitch a specific angle by email.

name: Smash.vc

rules_quotes.quote: Native English, no AI sludge.
We don’t chase “perfect,” but we reject translation-artifact drafts and obvious AI output nobody edited.

notes: Investor blog on SaaS, startups and acquisitions; writers pitch guest post ideas via the write-for-us page.

name: Videomaker
notes: Video production magazine; freelancers send a short query with outline, resume and samples, not full manuscripts.

name: Vmaker Blog

rules_quotes.quote: We offer only one do-follow backlink per article (DA must greater then 35)
You can submit guest posts for free, and no publishing fee is involved.

notes: Video and screen recording company blog; email three to four topic ideas for video marketing and learning posts.

name: Filmmaking Stuff

rules_quotes.quote: Your article should be 95% informative.
However, you are welcome to include a bio and one call to action at the end.

notes: Independent filmmaking blog; filmmakers email an article pitch with at least three practical tips.

name: The Podcast Host

rules_quotes.quote: how many articles can you commit to per week/month

notes: Podcasting how-to site; writers apply through a short form with two sample articles.

name: FOSS Force
notes: Free and open source software news site; send a query through the contact form with writing samples.

name: HackerNoon

rules_quotes.quote: You can submit as many as you one for how as often as you one.
Contributing writers are also welcome to republish their content wherever and whenever they see fit - we appreciate a mention and link back but it is completely optional.
The author bio is prime real estate for 140 characters about the company, 5 social profile links and one very prominent call to action linked to anywhere sensical on the interwebs.

notes: Technology publication where anyone can write and submit a story for editorial review; brands pay an author fee.

name: No Film School
notes: Filmmaking news and education site; email the editor a specific pitch with potential headlines.

name: Podnews

rules_quotes.quote: Sponsors and supporters are not given any editorial control of stories within the main newsletter, nor given any guarantee we’ll cover a story.

notes: Daily podcasting industry newsletter; send news, launches and press releases by email to the editor.

name: We Are Founders
notes: Startup blog publishing founder stories; founders apply through a short submission form.

name: A List Apart

rules_quotes.quote: Please don’t send us press releases or sales pitches.

notes: Web design and development magazine; send a draft or a short pitch with an outline.

name: Towards AI

rules_quotes.quote: disclose AI-generated text within the first two paragraphs and label AI-generated images in their captions.
Articles promoting a company or product follow our sponsorship process

notes: AI engineering publication on Medium; follow it and submit an unpublished Medium draft.

name: Nexa Growth Blog

rules_quotes.quote: We do not accept AI-generated content in any form.
We do not publish promotional content in editorial format.
You may include one do-follow link in your author bio.

notes: B2B digital marketing and SaaS blog; pitch each idea individually and write only original, human-written pieces.

name: Claudiv

rules_quotes.quote: Low-quality AI-generated articles published without human editing will not be accepted.
Excessive promotional links may be removed.

notes: AI and technology blog; submit original guest posts, sponsored posts are handled separately.

name: Wavel AI Blog

rules_quotes.quote: Content that is overly promotional for your company is not allowed.
Only link to your site if it’s a highly relevant blog post.

notes: AI video and dubbing company blog; agree a topic and title first, then share a Google Doc.

name: Better Stack Community

rules_quotes.quote: You can submit another idea immediately.

notes: Developer guides on observability and DevOps; submit an article idea and get paid after approval.

name: Who's Mailing What!

rules_quotes.quote: No more than one link to your company's website in the body of the guest post.
Anything that's too promotional for your company or organization.

notes: Direct mail and email marketing blog; email a pitch with the subject line format given on the page.

name: Best Startup US

rules_quotes.quote: We allow genuine contributions and backlinking to appropriate sources.
Guest posts submitted on behalf of businesses will have a sponsored post banner linking to the business.

notes: American startup magazine; pitch an article and an editor replies with a decision.

name: The Startup Magazine
notes: Startup and entrepreneurship magazine; send a 500 to 1000 word pitch through the contribution form.

name: freeCodeCamp News

rules_quotes.quote: Don't submit any text written by AI.
It is perfectly fine to have a one-sentence call-to-action for your product at the end of your tutorial

notes: Programming tutorials publication; writers submit a draft via Hashnode after the contributor process.

name: Social Media Today

rules_quotes.quote: You are encouraged to submit new content often.
NO SALES PITCHES: We do not accept content that is promotional or commercial in nature.
We do accept (and encourage) high-quality and relevant links, but any links that aren’t informational in nature will be removed without notice.

notes: Social media marketing news site; approved contributors post articles through an online submission form.

name: The Rundown AI
notes: Daily AI newsletter; submit a tool by form or email for the tools directory, or buy a newsletter feature.

name: Changelog News

rules_quotes.quote: Submitting your own work is also encouraged.

notes: Developer news newsletter and podcast; sign in and submit a link with a short note on why it is interesting.

name: Creative Boom

rules_quotes.quote: If you'd like guaranteed coverage on Creative Boom, check out our advertising opportunities

notes: Design and creative industry magazine; email news, project features or Insight pitches to the relevant editor address.

name: Inc42

rules_quotes.quote: The article should not contain more than 2 link backs (One should be in Author Bio)
An article shouldn’t be promoting any particular brand or the brands associated with the author directly or indirectly.

notes: Indian startup news site; submit a guest post as a document of at least 500 words.

name: Search Engine Journal

rules_quotes.quote: Therefore, we do not accept articles or content entirely generated by AI systems.
No self-promotional calls to action
SEJ prefers expert contributors commit to a recurring publishing date either monthly, every other month, or quarterly.

notes: Search and AI marketing news site; contributors are invited by the editors, who then evaluate pitched titles.

name: Mind the Product

rules_quotes.quote: Articles written to advertise a product or service will be rejected.
We don’t accept articles written solely by AI.

notes: Product management community and blog; submit a guest article through the online form for review.

name: InfoQ

rules_quotes.quote: We reject primarily AI-generated work.

notes: Software development news and articles; authors send an article proposal for editor review.

name: Yans Media Blog

rules_quotes.quote: The article can include one link to your website.

notes: Animation and explainer video studio blog; send a headline and summary with links to published work.
